methodDetails.scope: Independent current-source full-body supplement for exactly web/tests/process-remote.test.tsx. Previously sealed reports are unchanged. No source edits or prior audit conclusions used.
methodDetails.fullBody: Read all 704 lines, including imports, routed fetch/error fixture, beforeEach/afterEach cleanup, interactive process fixtures, deferred promise utilities, every test body, all parameterized case definitions and fake-timer pairing helpers.
methodDetails.processReview: Traced control payloads and one-write assertions; Ctrl+C/EOF draft retention; unchanged versus revised stdin drafts; selection and owner A-to-B-to-A races; not_sent/unknown receipt recovery without command replay; epoch, connection, disconnect and unmount transitions; delayed spawn/removal preserving current selection and text; explicit execution-account authorization; argv preservation without shell reinterpretation; authoritative snapshot output without duplicate event bytes; disconnect cleanup.
methodDetails.remoteReview: Traced explicit environment registration and independent remote-access confirmation, ephemeral default, credential clearing and lack of implicit session selection, owner-only pairing reads and secret removal, client revocation identity, every late success/failure versus expiry/new-pair/current-check ordering, disconnect/environment/connection/epoch/unmount changes including repeated identities, abort signaling despite intentionally abort-ignoring transport, current-check release and duplicate-click exclusion. Checked each assertion against the actual actions and controlled promise resolution/rejection; verified fake timers, globals and mocks are restored by cleanup hooks.
methodDetails.seal: Captured the file SHA-256 and snapshot(undefined, true) before review; rehashed the complete file and reran snapshot(undefined, true) over all 1,886 source paths at sealing. Both the file hash and full source digest stayed unchanged.
